preparedCanonicalSealJoinVerification.scope: Actual prepared SQL join; READ ONLY; five-second statement timeout; all four timestamps/heights/cardinalities reconciled with Core
preparedCanonicalSealJoinVerification.sql:
BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s'; SET LOCAL TIME ZONE 'UTC';
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (
SELECT cl.listing_id, cl.seal_txid, canonical_seal_event.seal_event_block_time,
canonical_seal_event.seal_event_block_height, canonical_seal_event.seal_event_match_count,
seal_tx.block_time AS seal_transaction_block_time
FROM proof_indexer.credit_listings cl
LEFT JOIN proof_indexer.transactions seal_tx ON seal_tx.network=cl.network AND seal_tx.txid=cl.seal_txid AND seal_tx.status='confirmed'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
      canonical_seal_event_row.payload AS seal_event_payload,
      canonical_seal_event_row.status AS seal_event_status,
      canonical_seal_event_row.txid AS seal_event_txid,
      canonical_seal_tx.block_hash AS seal_event_block_hash,
      canonical_seal_tx.block_time AS seal_event_block_time,
      canonical_seal_event_row.block_height AS seal_event_block_height,
      canonical_seal_event_row.block_index AS seal_event_block_index,
      canonical_seal_event_row.op_return_vout AS seal_event_protocol_vout,
      canonical_seal_event_row.record_ordinal AS seal_event_record_ordinal,
      COUNT(*) OVER () AS seal_event_match_count
    FROM proof_indexer.events canonical_seal_event_row
    JOIN proof_indexer.transactions canonical_seal_tx
      ON canonical_seal_tx.network = canonical_seal_event_row.network
     AND canonical_seal_tx.txid = canonical_seal_event_row.txid
     AND canonical_seal_tx.status = 'confirmed'
     AND canonical_seal_tx.block_height =
       canonical_seal_event_row.block_height
     AND canonical_seal_tx.block_index =
       canonical_seal_event_row.block_index
    JOIN proof_indexer.blocks canonical_seal_block
      ON canonical_seal_block.network = canonical_seal_tx.network
     AND canonical_seal_block.block_hash = canonical_seal_tx.block_hash
     AND canonical_seal_block.height = canonical_seal_tx.block_height
     AND canonical_seal_block.canonical = true
    WHERE canonical_seal_event_row.network = cl.network
      AND canonical_seal_event_row.txid = lower(cl.seal_txid)
      AND canonical_seal_event_row.valid = true
      AND canonical_seal_event_row.status = 'confirmed'
      AND canonical_seal_event_row.protocol = 'pwt1'
      AND canonical_seal_event_row.kind = 'token-listing-sealed'
      AND lower(canonical_seal_event_row.payload->>'listingId') =
        lower(cl.listing_id)
      AND lower(COALESCE(
        canonical_seal_event_row.payload->>'tokenId',
        canonical_seal_event_row.payload->'saleAuthorization'->>'tokenId',
        ''
      )) = lower(cl.token_id)
      AND (
        lower(COALESCE(cl.token_id, '')) <> 'd4e5ebf11d104d6a63fb74e42094364b25a5f7199a09e5c0e71408972466a8b8'
        OR (
          lower(COALESCE(
            cl.payload->'saleAuthorization'->>'version',
            ''
          )) IN (
            'pwt-sale-v3',
            'pwt-sale-v4',
            'pwt-sale-v5',
            'pwt-sale-v6',
            'pwt-sale-v8'
          )
          AND lower(COALESCE(
            canonical_seal_event_row.payload->'saleAuthorization'->>'version',
            ''
          )) = lower(COALESCE(
            cl.payload->'saleAuthorization'->>'version',
            ''
          ))
        )
      )
    ORDER BY
      canonical_seal_event_row.block_height DESC,
      canonical_seal_event_row.block_index DESC,
      canonical_seal_event_row.op_return_vout DESC,
      canonical_seal_event_row.record_ordinal DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) canonical_seal_event ON true
WHERE cl.network='livenet' AND cl.seal_txid=ANY(ARRAY['767b1c7d0df60edc9099ff29269b553843c896e397f550f5d7f8558834575c4b','4f895eaabd46d1c8d69b6ac953aa3776a861bf29951b99a6126b31413b2b15bd','3eb8cfcb5edb187cb77e2bc4ef4a3142a03c4897afe9a800613605e2d65e62e6','00943f5892cee2e9d4d097e9b6098629a7f5a080ccbd7c33b24c8de9685975a5'])
ORDER BY cl.seal_txid) r; ROLLBACK;
